dedupe_keys.name: geoportal pot santiago municipal gis layers and pmot plan maps of santiago de los caballeros dominican republic

description: The Geoportal POT Santiago is the GeoNode spatial data portal of the municipality of Santiago de los Caballeros in the Dominican Republic, set up for its municipal land-use plan (Plan Municipal de Ordenamiento Territorial, PMOT). On 28 September 2026 it held 96 resources: map layers such as the street network, public bus (OMSA) and shared-car (concho) routes, the cable car line 1 and its stations, irrigation canals, the cycle path, urban equipment, parks, hydrography, neighbourhoods and districts, historic centre parcels, topography, geology, seismic amplification and liquefaction, faults, soils, land cover from 1986 to 2015 and rainfall isohyets, plus PMOT documents on basic infrastructure networks (sanitation, water, drainage, energy and waste) and mobility. Coverage is the municipality and its districts; resolution is feature level. Format and access: GeoNode catalogue with a REST API and OGC WMS from its GeoServer; downloads per layer. Licence: most resources are marked public domain, a few not specified. Free. Caveats: resources were published between 2022 and 2026 and some describe older data (land cover from 1986, densities from 2010), and PMOT sheets are map documents, not data. Simulation uses: transport network and exposure models for a Caribbean city, including seismic amplification and liquefaction layers for earthquake scenarios. Related records: the ONE Dominican Republic Censo 2010 Redatam microdata and the INDOMET climate data give national context.
